meta.notes: Region pack region-sf (playtest 1c, 2026-09-30). The palette keys follow the renderer's material names (sky, water, road, shoulder, land, rail, markingCenter) plus fog and the row-house and cable-car colours, which paint the row-house and cable-car models (W-O, 2026-10-01); `fogBank` lays fog banks offshore. Chapter 3 assumes the Pacific Northwest is chapter 2 ("Pnw and sf first"); the order is the maintainer's call. The mix names three region vehicles (placeholder shapes from the base presets) beside base traffic; a kind listed nowhere never spawns. Every sign and billboard is placed by a billboard slot on the sf-hills roads.
